title: Oxlint Lint Target
description: Lints a project with Oxlint. Runs in batch mode by default, so one Oxlint process lints every project in the run, from the workspace root. Options not listed here are forwarded to Oxlint as CLI flags; paths in them are relative to the workspace root.

lintFilePatterns.description: One or more files/dirs/globs to pass to Oxlint.

nestedProjectRoots.description: Workspace-relative roots of projects nested inside this one. The executor excludes the ones that are not linting in the same run. The inferred target sets this.

format.description: Output format. Rendered by Nx from Oxlint's JSON report, so only these values are supported. `default` matches Oxlint's own terminal output, and switches to `agent` in CI or under an AI agent, as Oxlint does.

args.description: Extra arguments appended to the Oxlint command verbatim. Paths are relative to the workspace root, which is where Oxlint runs.
